description: On the red bed in front of you are two small white drawer-like furniture pieces, one standing upright with an open compartment and one separate drawer unit beside it. The left hand steadies the upright piece near the center while the right hand slides the separate drawer unit leftward toward it, aligns it, and pushes it into place so the two parts become a single stacked set of drawers; then the right hand releases while the left hand continues to hold the assembled unit briefly.
